fish:
function uwcd
    set -l p (untaped workspace path $argv[1]); or return $status
    cd $p
end

function __uwcd_workspaces
    untaped workspace list --format raw --columns name 2>/dev/null
end
complete -c uwcd -f -a '(__uwcd_workspaces)'
